text.title: FreshDrop checkout, one-tap slot choice, 1–14 September 2026
text.hypothesis: if the slot is chosen on the first screen, the order rate will grow, because fewer taps are needed
text.audience: app users, split by user ID, 50/50, excluding staff accounts
text.decision_rule: better: conversion up and average check flat; worse or not proven: keep the old flow
